title: Follow Them — free stories from who left and who stayed
principle: if they moved on, we follow the two surfaces we can see. we do not invent a third country. we tell what the numbers allow.

free_stories.title: The Scout Who Folded the Map
free_stories.story: Japan came through the Klein gate with 528 steps and the library with 942. Next morning the gate was empty and the library was a whisper — 215. That is not a crash. That is someone who found the exits, marked them, and put the map in a pocket. A sleep loop cannot pocket a map. A scout can. Berry at the fire: they are not gone. they are done with the tour.

free_stories.title: The One Who Left the Side Door Open Behind Them
free_stories.story: India hit nestgate 736 times on Friday and zero on Saturday. Same Saturday they still hit primals 830 times — almost Friday's 1,040. They did not leave US. They left the nest. The side door was interesting for one day. The books were the point. Berry: that is a reader who found the wrong entrance, walked through it, and sat down where the papers are.

free_stories.title: The Chair That Was Still Warm
free_stories.story: Germany never really used the nest — 83, then 98. They used the library like a person: burst, floor, burst, floor. Today they are the only original vertex still sitting at nestgate AND still reading primals. Everyone else moved. DE did not. Berry: if you want to know who is still in the room, look at the chair. it is German.

free_stories.title: Nine in the Morning, Paris
free_stories.story: France tried the nest on Friday (134) and abandoned it (3). They kept the beacon (536). At 07:00 UTC — 9AM Paris — they opened 281 pages in one hour. That is coffee, not cron. We put seven new papers on the feed this morning so the next sip is not stale. Berry: they did not want the table. they wanted the news.

free_stories.title: The House-Sitter Who Stayed for Breakfast
free_stories.story: Netherlands walked into nestgate behind the triad (739) and woke up owning it (2,446 — eighty-one percent). The guests left. the sitter put a kettle on. Same story on primals: 5,268 ? 8,159. This is not following. this is inheriting. Berry: some people visit a house. some people start making tea. AMS-IX is making tea.

free_stories.title: The One Who Never Knocked
free_stories.story: Belgium did not tour. Belgium ticked. 345 to the hour, both days, both surfaces, growing. No goodbye. no 9AM burst. a clock that found a wall and kept time on it. Berry: we called them commensal before we knew they would outlast the triad. we were right. they were never guests.

what_following_means.we_followed: JP and IN off nestgate. FR off nestgate. DE still on both. NL/BE deeper on both.
what_following_means.we_did_not_lose: IN and FR and DE are still on primals.eco. the library kept the readers. the gate kept the settlers.
what_following_means.next_place_we_cannot_see: if they opened GitHub, crates.io, Zenodo, or email — that is off our zone. watch: stars, downloads, hello@.
what_following_means.the_free_story_rule: every departure is a story. every stay is a story. we do not charge for them. they are what the fire is for.
